d: Part of the Roman forum, with imperial throne on one side. View of Rome illuminated in time at night with triumphal arches and other festive apparatuses prepared to celebrate the ten-year celebrations, and to honor the return of Ezio (winner of Attila) who is seen advancing preceded by wartime instroments, Schiavi, and insignia de' vinti, and followed by 'Soldati victori. Valentinian over the throne, Massimo, Varo with Pretoriani. Ezio, and Popolo.
Ezio, Massimo, and then Fulvia with Paggi, and some Slaves.
Imperial rooms enthusiast of paintings. Honor, and Varo.
Palatine gardens, corresponding to the imperial apartments, with boulevards, flower racks, and fountains continue. In the bottom water fall, and before grotesques, and statues. Massimo, then Fulvia.
Valentinian without mantle, and without laurel with bare sword, followed by Pretorians, and sayings.
Gallery of statues and mirrors, with seats around, among which one before from the right hand capable of two people. Large open balcony, in the perspective of which view of Rome. Onoria, and Massimo.
Atrium of the prisons with iron gates in prospect, which lead to several prisons, with Guards on sight on the door of the said gates. Honorary, indi Ezio with chains.
Ancient Capitol with People. Maximum without mantle with followed, and Varo in the background.

We see the imperial Guards coming down from the camp, fighting with the Lifted. Following the fight, which ended, Valentinian comes out without a mantle, with a broken sword, defending themselves from two Conspirators; and then Massimo with a sword, and Fulvia.
Ezio and Varo with bare swords, people and soldiers, ind Honoria, and sayings.
